history.content: How much room do I have this week?

Checked your calendar for Mon Sep 28 through Sun Oct 4. Here's what's on it: BigCo interview, Mon 2:00 PM Gym, Mon 6:30 PM Dentist, Tue 9:00 AM Team standup, Wed 9:15 AM Dinner with Dana, Wed 7:30 PM So the week is genuinely light: Monday has the interview plus gym, Tuesday is just the early dentist, and Wednesday has standup and dinner. Thursday, Friday, and the weekend are completely open. Two things I haven't checked: your email for anything that might add itself to the week, and any reminders or to dos sitting outside the calendar. Want me to look?
